parallelFirst: [cc-slaves] Parallel session #{n} of {project}. Call `lanes_list`; only command your own lanes.
estPct: no cache left: re-reads {tok} tok ≈ {pct} % of {acc}'s 5-hour quota (estimated from {n} samples)
estNoPct: re-reads {tok} tok (not enough data to turn into % of quota)
head: Session #{n}
readOnly: View only — this session has ended. To message it, click "Resume…".
readOnlyRemote: View only — this session has ended. It can be resumed from the Mac.
parLead: Adds an orchestrator for {project}, running next to {others}. Lanes it opens hang off their own root.
parName: Session name (optional, ≤ 24 chars; empty = first 24 chars of the first message)
parNote: Lanes of {others} stay with {others}. Every session sees every lane but only commands its own. At most {max} sessions run at once per project.
endLead: #{n} writes a handoff, then closes. Find it in Session history; it can resume for {days} days.
endStopped: #{n} is stopped — no handoff. Find it in Session history.
endNote: Lanes keep running; only the orchestrator they report to changes. To stop #{n}'s lanes use "Safe-stop lanes of #{n}…".
endAsks: #{n}'s own questions waiting for you will expire: {list}
newConfirm: Replace #{n} with a new session? #{n} writes a handoff and closes; the new session takes its lanes.
ctxHigh: {val} — compacts right after the first turn, details are lost
optParNote: Adds root #{n} to the deck; running sessions keep running (will be {k} / {max} sessions).
optRepNote: The chosen session writes a handoff and closes; its lanes move to #{n}.
optRepNoteNew: The chosen session writes a handoff and closes; its lanes move to the new session.
resNote: The engine sends #{n} a first message with the lanes as they are now, so it does not act on what it knew {ago} ago.
fromTail: New session from the last 50 lines
fromLeadHandoff: The new session gets a new number and reads #{n}'s handoff as context.
fromLeadTail: The new session gets a new number and reads the last 50 lines the engine kept of #{n} as context.
stAutoNone: Auto · no account can be used
stWhyOut: sign in again in the Account panel
stWhyProbe: needs a test run in the Account panel before taking work
stWhyAnthWeek: Anthropic reports the weekly limit reached
stNone: Every signed-in account is full, takes no new work or is signed out. Earliest: {email} reopens {at}. Open the list to see why for each account.
stNoneNoAt: Every signed-in account is full, takes no new work or is signed out. Open the list to see why for each account.
stOffline: Lost connection to the engine — reconnecting. Your choices are kept; you can start once it reconnects.
stNote: Applies to this session only. Once it opens, change model / effort on the session chip like any other session.
stLeadNew: Opens a Design session for {project}. Write the idea in the composer; the session uses brainstorming to produce the spec and mockup.
stLeadBuild: Opens a Build session for {path}, then switches to the Deck.
stLeadDesign: Opens a Design session bound to {path}, then switches to the Deck.
stLeadResume: Takes over session {what}, then switches to the Deck.
stRunLead: Switches to the Deck when done. You can close this box; the session keeps opening.
stBadLeadAcc: No session was created. Pick another account and try again.
stBadLead: No session was created. Try again, or close the box.
stBadLeadBoot: The session stopped while starting. Try again, or close the box.
stStepBootSlow: Claude has not answered after 30 seconds — still waiting
stStepFirst: Send the session its first message
stStepDeck: Switch to the Deck, select the session
stNoteResume: Applies to this session only. Another account: the old session goes on under the new account (like "Resume" in v2.4).
bootWait: Waiting for the session to start…
